ask: Is the new Say it section right, and can you send a few partner clips for the test set?
problem: Teams find a missed key term only at the consultant stage and redo the draft. The app cannot check a take for a term yet.
found: The app keeps written words and a manual tie to a take. It has no recording of how the team says a word, so nothing to compare a take with. The issue cited decision 54, which is about joining a team.
changed: A key word's page has a new Say it section. The team records two or three examples of the word and plays them back. A new script scores how well a matcher finds words in passages. No matcher yet.
why: The old written word must not change, so this is a new kind of record. The result stays a hint on the phone. Pictures are drawn from the app's colours; no live app ran here. Database checks did not run here, so wait for the PR checks.
touches: A new database migration. 15 translations I wrote need a native reader. Phones download the new clips. Play store answers stay the same.
